entry.title: Audio selection and consumers
entry.fresh_independent_judgment: All six selection entries retain their own preset/map/global/fixed fallback. Ordered trainer arrays use the last non-nil field, including a real empty string which causes fallback; the direct type helper retains empty text. The fixed Scripts search found only the FromType definition, leaving dynamic/plugin callers unknown. Existing intro memory is preserved including its pending timer; without memory a nonempty intro cancels a pending timer and saves queued Q at position0 or current track/position before playback. Empty intro does not change memory. Selection does not clear presets; normal outer return does. Capture requests ME and a 3.5-second wait through the no-opponent branch.
entry.positive_and_reverse_design: [A,nil] preserves A, [A,empty] falls back, direct empty type remains empty. Test existing memory versus absent memory and empty versus nonempty intro as distinct pre-playback designs. Host playback/media is unverified.

entry.title: Automatic adjustment algorithm
entry.fresh_independent_judgment: Stage23 collects side0 then side1 plans from the original live layout. Any near pair breaks collection while preserving previously collected plans; single-seat sides skip and same-owner eligibility applies. Execution requires real endpoints with the same owner. Multiple plans skip only a two-seat-side plan, allowing three-seat plans without recomputing proximity after the first swap. Qualified 3v3 live0/1 gives2/3; 3v2 gives2/1; legal player-three-owners/opponent-one-owner gives0/3. The forbidden two-multi-owner layout is not evidence.
entry.positive_and_reverse_design: A preexisting near pair gives no new plan; asymmetric1v3 only0/5 moves5→3. Missing or different-owner endpoints block their swap. Stage23 unreached after terminal exit promises no movement.

root_adjudications.rationale: WP42按源排除不足以独立决定交换计划。源先遍历侧0/1预收全部候选，再执行，不在每次成功后重判近邻；3v3六席对象均存在、各侧单业主、仅0/1存活、2/3为已濒死中央且无后备时，计划0↔2及1↔3并依次都执行，最终存活2/3；不是先移动一侧后停止。两席侧在候选总数>1时排除该侧交换，三席侧不套该门；现WP41仅手动Shift不能补齐。
root_adjudications.evidence: root/peer-reading-log.tsv and exact additional source ranges therein
root_adjudications.scope_limitations: Static only; no reference execution; original D judgment unchanged

minimum_revision.value: 将按源排除改为完整的行为条件、候选次序、每侧/全局终止条件，并给至少单侧可移与两侧可移的固定例。

determinate_recheck.value: 给定席位、存活、业主与空位分布即可唯一算出自动交换序列；不需要源文件来补排除条件。

value: 3v3仅0和1存活且均可与本侧空中央交换时，先将0移至2即令双方邻近，随后停止。
同一前提先将1移至3，或双方都移至中央；都符合寻找同业主空/中央位概括，但最终占位及指向效果不同。

acceptance_gate: Inherit current qualifications, effective case constraints and final adjudications; historical/raw wording cannot enlarge or override final scope.
Every assigned counterexample has explicit premises, ordered state changes/partial failure, unique static expected result and neighboring reverse contrast.
Final body, supplied data/appendix, test row and successor traceability agree; original immutable artifacts remain unchanged.
Candidate frozen identity, independent Ultra scoped review, actual integration affected check and all contributor records exist before closure.
Retain U01-U10/G01-G12/AX01-AX20, 0 runtime observations, 0 proven demo chains and optional/nonrequired scope.

entry.control_application: Applied all current qualifications, effective second-review conditions, precedence, root adjudications, extensions/extension decisions and determinate minimum recheck fields for this contribution. Literal agreement is independently checked against fixed objects; source reasoning above is a new judgment, not the historical candidate prose.

applies_to: Accepted other-batch scope only; B17 remains unaccepted.
